eyebrow: Why e^(i theta) Traces a Circle
code:
e^x (real x): grows without bound

e^(i*theta): cos(theta)^2 + sin(theta)^2 = 1, always

as theta increases, e^(i*theta) moves around the unit circle
-- never grows, just rotates
caption: A phase is a position on the unit circle, not a magnitude — the geometric picture behind every quantum phase.
